title: Recurrence versus half-density percolation in disk triangulations
exact_target: Must half-density site percolation on a recurrent bounded-degree disc triangulation have only finite clusters?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000053 (AMR-099-0053). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini, \emph{Percolation and Coarse Conformal Uniformization}, June 2015; original author manuscript preserved in Arquivo.pt capture of 31 December 2020, Section 2, converse question at bottom of p. 3.
